title: Beyond Output Faithfulness: Diagnosing and Mitigating Pathway Rerouting in Feature Attribution
abstract: arXiv:2509.04588v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Insertion and deletion are standard metrics for evaluating feature   attributions by progressively adding or removing pixels. While they test   whether attributed features control a model output, they do not verify   whether they do so through the computation that supports the clean   prediction. We study this distinction with Ensemble Quantile Optimization (EQO),   a differentiable method that directly optimizes the insertion sequence.   On CNNs, Unconstrained EQO attains the highest insertion scores while departing   from clean representations and retaining its insertion score after channels   supporting the clean prediction are ablated. Together, these results reveal   pathway rerouting that output-only metrics cannot detect. translated_title: 超越输出忠实性：诊断与缓解特征归因中的通路重路由
translated_abstract: 插入和删除是通过逐步添加或移除像素来评估特征归因的标准指标。虽然它们能测试被归因的特征是否控制模型输出，但并未验证这些特征是否通过支持原始（干净）预测的计算路径来实现这一控制。我们使用集成分位数优化来研究这一区别，这是一种直接优化插入序列的可微方法。在CNN上，无约束EQO在偏离干净表示的同时取得了最高的插入分数，并且在消融支持干净预测的通道后仍保持其插入分数。这些结果共同揭示了一种仅靠输出指标无法检测到的“通路重路由”现象。在Vision Transformer上，来自黑色输入的目标预测和注意力偏差同样暴露了这一失败。为解决该问题，我们提出了ClipGrad，一种逐层梯度过滤器，它保留……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 论文发现插入/删除等仅输出指标无法检测特征归因是否经由支持原始预测的计算路径，提出了可微的EQO方法揭示“通路重路由”现象，并引入逐层梯度过滤器ClipGrad来缓解该问题。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that output-only metrics like insertion/deletion cannot detect whether attributed features act through the computation supporting the clean prediction—a failure termed "pathway rerouting"—and proposes a differentiable EQO method to expose it and a layer-wise gradient filter ClipGrad to mitigate it.
